day5_morning_plan_escape.speaker: me
day5_morning_plan_escape.text: *Last night, the plan was escape. First, getting out alive. Evidence could wait.*

day5_morning_plan_expose.speaker: me
day5_morning_plan_expose.text: *Last night, the plan was exposure. Getting out alive and leaving a record—I decided not to miss either.*

day5_morning_plan_confront.speaker: me
day5_morning_plan_confront.text: *Last night, the plan was confrontation. I wouldn't run; I'd see it to the end, I wrote with trembling hands.*

day5_morning_dawn_1.speaker: me
day5_morning_dawn_1.text: *4 AM. I couldn't sleep. No — I wasn't allowed to sleep.*

day5_morning_dawn_2.speaker: me
day5_morning_dawn_2.text: *I check the clock in the darkness. The fluorescent hands tremble. — No, it's my hands that are trembling.*

day5_morning_dawn_3.speaker: me
day5_morning_dawn_3.text: *I check my bag. Yuna's camera — making sure the lens isn't cracked. The photos taken in the basement — I removed the memory card and put it in my pocket separately. If they take my bag, it's over. Phone — 68% battery. I debated whether to bring the charger, then shoved it in. No telling when I'll get to use it.*

day5_morning_dawn_4.speaker: me
day5_morning_dawn_4.text: *I pulled out my notebook. The plan I wrote last night. My handwriting was so shaky that half of it is barely legible. But it's all in my head. My body remembers. — I've repeated this 12 times, after all.*

day5_morning_dawn_5.speaker: me
day5_morning_dawn_5.text: *I tied my sneakers tight. I might have to run.*

day5_morning_dawn_6.speaker: me
day5_morning_dawn_6.text: *I stood at the door. Paused for a moment.*

day5_morning_dawn_7.speaker: me
day5_morning_dawn_7.text: *Beyond the door. The hallway. Is the hallway of a studio apartment always this quiet at 4 AM? No — it was always quiet. It's just that before, the silence was just silence.*

day5_morning_dawn_8.speaker: me
day5_morning_dawn_8.text: *I held my breath and opened the door. The hallway. Only the green glow of emergency lights. No one's here.*

day5_morning_dawn_9.speaker: me
day5_morning_dawn_9.text: *The absence of anyone — feels more wrong. If they're watching, I'd rather they be somewhere I can see.*

day5_morning_dawn_10.speaker: me
day5_morning_dawn_10.text: *I went down the stairs. Muffled my footsteps. The predawn streets. Streetlights glowing orange. No signs of life. No cars. Just the wind.*

day5_morning_dawn_11.speaker: me
day5_morning_dawn_11.text: *I'm alone. Completely alone. ...No. I've always been alone for 12 cycles. Every time losing my memory, every time from the start, every time knowing nothing. If that's not being alone, what is?*

day5_morning_dawn_12.speaker: me
day5_morning_dawn_12.text: *I walked. 20 minutes to school. The predawn roads are empty, with only my footsteps echoing. I'm heading to school. I need to save Yuna first.*

day5_morning_school_1.speaker: me
day5_morning_school_1.text: *The school came into view. Only the building's silhouette visible in the darkness. Normally it was just a school. Now — it's just the husk of something.*

day5_morning_school_2.speaker: me
day5_morning_school_2.text: *The front gate is open. No lock. Just — open.*

day5_morning_school_3.speaker: me
day5_morning_school_3.text: *The iron gate sways slightly in the wind, half-open. Creak, creak. The sound amplifies in my ears.*

day5_morning_school_4.speaker: me
day5_morning_school_4.text: *Of course. This school isn't a prison. There's no need to lock the gates.*

day5_morning_school_5.speaker: me
day5_morning_school_5.text: ***You just erase the memories of anyone who tries to escape.***

day5_morning_school_6.speaker: me
day5_morning_school_6.text: *That single line echoed in my head. Escaping was meaningless. For 12 cycles. Running, hiding, screaming — I always ended up back at the beginning. Erasing memories was all it took to nullify every escape.*

day5_morning_school_7.speaker: me
day5_morning_school_7.text: *But the 13th time is different. Riin switched the drugs. My memories remain. — And Riin told me. She said she'd disable the tracking system before dawn today. "That's all I can do. Two hours at most." If I fail this time — there might not be a next time.*

day5_morning_school_8.speaker: me
day5_morning_school_8.text: *I passed through the front gate and crossed the schoolyard. Sand crunches beneath my feet. Past the main building toward the old wing. I must have walked this path 12 times. I don't remember, but my feet know.*

day5_morning_school_9.speaker: me
day5_morning_school_9.text: *The entrance to the old wing. The door is open. Inside is pitch black. I turned on my phone flashlight. The beam swept across the hallway.*

day5_morning_school_10.speaker: me
day5_morning_school_10.text: *Something's written on the wall. — Graffiti? No. These are scratches made by fingernails. Unreadable. Who, when, why. Was it 'me' from a previous cycle?*

day5_morning_school_11.speaker: me
day5_morning_school_11.text: *The stairs leading down to the basement. Step by step, the concrete is cold. Somewhere, a pipe resonates. Thump, thump, thump. Like a heartbeat.*

day5_morning_rescue_1.speaker: me
day5_morning_rescue_1.text: *The phone light swept across the basement. Pipes, filing cabinets, old medical equipment. — And a bed in the corner.*

day5_morning_rescue_2.speaker: me
day5_morning_rescue_2.text: *Yuna is strapped to the bed. She's conscious but drugged. Leather restraints are wrapped around her wrists, her skin rubbed raw and red. Signs of struggling.*

day5_morning_rescue_2_unknown.speaker: me
day5_morning_rescue_2_unknown.text: *...Who is she? An unfamiliar girl lies collapsed. ...I need to help her regardless.*

day5_morning_rescue_4_unknown.speaker: me
day5_morning_rescue_4_unknown.text: *A strange face, but the voice strangely lingers. No time to think. Freeing them is the priority.*

day5_morning_rescue_5_unknown.speaker: unknown
day5_morning_rescue_5_unknown.text: ...I'm Choi Yuna. Photography club. I'll explain on the way out.

day5_morning_rescue_4.speaker: me
day5_morning_rescue_4.text: *Yuna's voice is hoarse. How long has she been here?*

day5_morning_rescue_5.speaker: yuna
day5_morning_rescue_5.text: ...You saw the records... down here, right?

day5_morning_rescue_5a.speaker: me
day5_morning_rescue_5a.text: *Yuna's finger points to the scattered pile of documents on the floor. A trembling hand. The direction is clear.*

day5_morning_rescue_7.speaker: me
day5_morning_rescue_7.text: *I undid the leather straps binding Yuna. The knots were tight. My nails scraped raw before I finally got them undone. Yuna's hands are cold. — Mine are too.*

day5_morning_rescue_8.speaker: yuna
day5_morning_rescue_8.text: ...Actually, I... knew too. Since the 8th time.

day5_morning_rescue_9.speaker: yuna
day5_morning_rescue_9.text: The 8th you... asked me to take photos. 'Record who I was,' you said.

day5_morning_rescue_10.speaker: yuna
day5_morning_rescue_10.text: ...That person's name was 'Choi Siwoo.' Tall, quiet, always sitting alone in the corner of the library.

day5_morning_rescue_11.speaker: yuna
day5_morning_rescue_11.text: One day he just showed up — eyes bloodshot — and said, 'Yuna, I have one favor. Take my picture. Record who I was.'

day5_morning_rescue_12.speaker: yuna
day5_morning_rescue_12.text: ...I didn't understand what he meant. Back then. I just thought he was a strange upperclassman.

day5_morning_rescue_13.speaker: yuna
day5_morning_rescue_13.text: ...The next week, that person — transferred in under a different name. Same face, but he didn't recognize me.

day5_morning_rescue_15.speaker: yuna
day5_morning_rescue_15.text: ...That's when I started taking photos. Every time. The 9th, the 10th, the 11th, the 12th.

day5_morning_rescue_16.speaker: yuna
day5_morning_rescue_16.text: The 9th was 'Han Jiho.' He caught on fast. From Day 3, he kept asking me the same questions. And that night, he suddenly disappeared.

day5_morning_rescue_17.speaker: yuna
day5_morning_rescue_17.text: ...Every time the name was different, but every time the same request. 'Record me.' ...I guess even when memories are erased, the body remembers.

day5_morning_rescue_18.speaker: yuna
day5_morning_rescue_18.text: ...Three years, sunbae. For three years, I watched the same person come under different names, forget everything, and make the same request again.

day5_morning_rescue_19.speaker: me
day5_morning_rescue_19.text: *Tears welled in Yuna's eyes, but they didn't fall.*

day5_morning_rescue_20.speaker: yuna
day5_morning_rescue_20.text: ...I was scared. Every time. But if I ran — there'd be no one left to keep the record.

day5_morning_rescue_21.speaker: me
day5_morning_rescue_21.text: *Deja vu pin #9: "Record me" — asking Yuna to take photos wasn't the first time. A behavior repeated every cycle.*

day5_morning_rescue_22.speaker: me
day5_morning_rescue_22.text: *I helped Yuna to her feet. Her legs gave out and she staggered. I put her arm over my shoulder.*

day5_morning_escape_end.speaker: me
day5_morning_escape_end.text: *I grabbed Yuna's arm and headed up the stairs. Getting out comes first.*

day5_morning_true_1.speaker: me
day5_morning_true_1.text: *I searched through the documents. I found them where Yuna had pointed.*

day5_morning_true_2.speaker: me
day5_morning_true_2.text: *#7 - Photo: a long-haired male student. Name: Kim Taeho. ...A ravaged face. Cheeks hollow enough to show bone. The angle of the cheekbones. The corners of the eyes. But the face - is mine.*

day5_morning_true_3.speaker: me
day5_morning_true_3.text: *The remarks for #7 are long. 'Marked drug resistance. Contact with facility student Lee Seolhwa (female). Conspired to escape. Result: subject secured, Lee Seolhwa permanently processed. Subject fully erased and reintroduced.'*

day5_morning_true_4.speaker: yuna
day5_morning_true_4.text: ...Lee Seolhwa... the girl you talk to in the hallway... she's in here...

day5_morning_true_5.speaker: me
day5_morning_true_5.text: *Yuna can't continue. Her breathing is ragged. Because of the drugs.*

day5_morning_true_6.speaker: me
day5_morning_true_6.text: *More documents are scattered across the floor. There's no time to read them. I photographed them with my phone. Even one more page matters.*

day5_morning_true_7.speaker: yuna
day5_morning_true_7.text: Sunbae... over there... that might be Ms. Eunsu's journal...

day5_morning_true_8.speaker: me
day5_morning_true_8.text: *Yuna points while leaning against the bed. Another stack of documents. Clean handwriting. Tidy sentences. Sentences that describe people like objects. - Ms. Eunsu's observation log.*

day5_morning_true_9.speaker: me
day5_morning_true_9.text: ***'Trial #7 Remarks: Drug resistance. External contact confirmed with facility student Lee Seolhwa (female, 17). Attempted escape in collusion. Result: Lee Seolhwa - deemed uncorrectable, permanently isolated. Subject - full memory erasure, then reintroduced as #8.'***

day5_morning_true_10.speaker: me
day5_morning_true_10.text: *...Seolhwa. A facility student. During the 7th cycle... the person who tried to escape with me.*

day5_morning_true_11.speaker: me
day5_morning_true_11.text: ***And the person who was 'permanently isolated' while my memories were being erased.***

day5_morning_true_12.speaker: me
day5_morning_true_12.text: *...'Permanently isolated.' Elsewhere in the document, it says 'disposed of.' It means the same thing.*

day5_morning_true_13.speaker: me
day5_morning_true_13.text: *...Seolhwa. The girl sitting in the back of the classroom. Is she the same 'Lee Seolhwa' in these records?*

day5_morning_true_14.speaker: me
day5_morning_true_14.text: ***'Post-Trial #8 Observation: Subject repeatedly attempts conversation into empty space. Shows a defense mechanism relying on a nonexistent other person, referred to as "Lee Seolhwa." Presumed residual memory aggregation. Drug dosage requires review.'***

day5_morning_true_15.speaker: me
day5_morning_true_15.text: *...Ms. Eunsu wrote this. The same person who smiled while looking at me. She wrote, 'Drug dosage requires review.'*

day5_morning_true_16.speaker: me
day5_morning_true_16.text: ***'Trials #9-#12: Same phenomenon persists. Subject perceives "Lee Seolhwa" in every cycle, but the individual was already disposed of at the conclusion of Trial #7. Confirmed as hallucination.'***

day5_morning_true_17.speaker: me
day5_morning_true_17.text: ***'Addendum: Subject's dependency on hallucinations is high. Forced removal risks mental collapse. At this stage, non-intervention is rational. Intervention is unnecessary as long as the hallucinations contribute to the subject's stability.'***

day5_morning_true_18.speaker: me
day5_morning_true_18.text: *...Non-intervention. They knew I was seeing hallucinations of a dead person — yet they just left me alone, 'because it contributed to my stability'.*

day5_morning_true_20.speaker: me
day5_morning_true_20.text: ***The girl who sat in the back of the classroom. The girl who watched me from the hallway. The girl who said, 'Remember me.'***

day5_morning_true_21.speaker: me
day5_morning_true_21.text: ***All of it — it was all created in my mind.***

day5_morning_true_22.speaker: me
day5_morning_true_22.text: *The last page of the observation log. The date was two days ago.*

day5_morning_true_23.speaker: me
day5_morning_true_23.text: ***'Trial #13 Day 2 Observation: Contact with Choi Yuna (external observer) confirmed. Risk of evidence leakage. Immediate isolation recommended.'***

day5_morning_true_24.speaker: me
day5_morning_true_24.text: ***'Trial #13 Day 3 Addendum: Choi Yuna's isolation complete. Board report withheld — reporting would expose the external observer, resulting in a project security failure and potential subject termination. Internal processing followed by a delayed report is planned.'***

day5_morning_true_25.speaker: me
day5_morning_true_25.text: *...Two days ago. The very day Yuna showed me the photo. Eunsu knew about it.*

day5_morning_true_27.speaker: me
day5_morning_true_27.text: ***Seolhwa died a year ago. She died for me. And I, with my memories erased—was eating and laughing with the people who killed her.***

day5_morning_true_28.speaker: me
day5_morning_true_28.text: *I saw Yuna. She read this too. Alone. Tied up.*

day5_morning_true_29.speaker: yuna_full
day5_morning_true_29.text: ...I need to... get out of here. They're... coming soon.

day5_morning_true_30.speaker: yuna_full
day5_morning_true_30.text: Sunbae... Ms. Riin will be down soon. She always comes to give the medicine.

day5_morning_true_31.speaker: me
day5_morning_true_31.text: *Yuna grabs onto me. Her grip is weak.*

day5_morning_true_32.speaker: yuna_full
day5_morning_true_32.text: ...Sunbae. Everything's in this camera. Three years' worth... who you really were.

day5_morning_true_33.speaker: yuna_full
day5_morning_true_33.text: If we get out of here... you have to take this with you...

day5_morning_true_34.speaker: me
day5_morning_true_34.text: *I took Yuna's hand. It was cold.*

day5_morning_true_35.speaker: me
day5_morning_true_35.text: *I quickly photographed the scattered documents on the floor. The Edina Foundation logo. Project Nevergrad Final Report. Someone had already compiled this into a business plan.*

day5_morning_true_36.speaker: me
day5_morning_true_36.text: *Identity Package Change Protocol. My parents, my hometown, my entire remembered past—all laid out in a table. My life is just design data.*

day5_morning_true_37.speaker: me
day5_morning_true_37.text: *Board approval documents. Commercialization proposals. My suffering was just investment material for someone.*

day5_morning_true_38.speaker: me
day5_morning_true_38.text: *The last page. 'Operation #13 Special Notes: Subject continuously perceives hallucinations (Lee Seolhwa — #7, designated for disposal). Residual memory aggregation threshold exceeded. Early termination before Day 5 requires review.'*

day5_morning_true_39.speaker: me
day5_morning_true_39.text: *The words 'Early Processing Review' burned into my eyes. It meant they might not even give us five days.*

day5_morning_true_timer_choice.speaker: me
day5_morning_true_timer_choice.text: *No matter what choice I make — there's no time.*

day5_morning_true_run_1.speaker: me
day5_morning_true_run_1.text: *I shoved the evidence into my bag and grabbed Yuna's arm.*

day5_morning_true_hide_1.speaker: me
day5_morning_true_hide_1.text: *I hid in the shadows behind the filing cabinets. I put a finger to my lips, trying to keep Yuna's trembling breaths from being heard. Footsteps passed by on the stairs above.*

day5_morning_true_hide_2.speaker: me
day5_morning_true_hide_2.text: *...But I can't stay here much longer. I have to move eventually.*

day5_morning_true_exit_1.speaker: me
day5_morning_true_exit_1.text: *As I climbed the stairs — Ms. Eunsu stood there, blocking the hallway towards the old building's exit.*

day5_morning_true_exit_2.speaker: eunsu_full
day5_morning_true_exit_2.text: {name}... Can you explain what you're doing here?

day5_morning_true_ft.speaker: me
day5_morning_true_ft.text: *Her smile is too natural. Beside me, Yuna is gripping the camera tight. How am I supposed to answer.*
choices: Move aside, ma'am. I know everything we saw downstairs.
...I got lost. Sorry, I'll head out right now.
Yuna suddenly got dizzy. I'm taking her to the nurse.

day5_morning_true_ft_confront.speaker: eunsu_full
day5_morning_true_ft_confront.text: ...{name}, that's a frightening thing to say. Want to sit down with me and talk this through? Put the camera down for a second.

day5_morning_true_ft_lost.speaker: eunsu_full
day5_morning_true_ft_lost.text: It's all right. You're not hurt? - I'll walk you back. Take your time.

day5_morning_true_ft_yuna.speaker: eunsu_full
day5_morning_true_ft_yuna.text: ...I see. The nurse's office is on the second floor of the main building though, {name}. Let's go together. I'll help you carry her.

day5_morning_true_ft_stall.speaker: eunsu_full
day5_morning_true_ft_stall.text: Hold on. Slow down. — Hear the teacher out before you go, hm?

day5_morning_true_post_ft_1.speaker: me
day5_morning_true_post_ft_1.text: *Ms. Eunsu placed a hand on my shoulder. It was warm. But what was behind that smile?*

day5_morning_true_post_ft_2.speaker: me
day5_morning_true_post_ft_2.text: *The teacher didn't immediately grab me. Instead, they cast their gaze upwards. At that moment, the sound of a metal door slamming shut echoed from somewhere.*

day5_morning_true_post_ft_3.speaker: me
day5_morning_true_post_ft_3.text: *...It's a trap. That face, watching to see how far I'd go, what I'd grab, where I'd run. I grabbed Yuna's wrist and brushed past the teacher.*

day5_morning_blockade_1.speaker: me
day5_morning_blockade_1.text: *I came up the stairs. End of the hallway — the door is shut. The door that was open until yesterday. A steel locking bar is in place. That wasn't there yesterday.*

day5_morning_blockade_2.speaker: me
day5_morning_blockade_2.text: *I ran to the opposite end. The other hallway door — also shut. Locked.*

day5_morning_blockade_4.speaker: me
day5_morning_blockade_4.text: *My eyes met Yuna's. Her face is white. Mine must look the same.*

day5_morning_blockade_5.speaker: me
day5_morning_blockade_5.text: *Ksshht— Static burst from the speakers. Then — a sound beneath it. A music box. Slow, off-key music box melody. Like a warped version of a graduation hymn.*

day5_morning_broadcast_2.speaker: me
day5_morning_broadcast_2.text: *Ms. Eunsu's voice echoes through the speakers. The same warm tone as always. That warmth — now it makes me sick.*

day5_morning_broadcast_3.speaker: eunsu
day5_morning_broadcast_3.text: Today is a special day. We have a **graduation ceremony**.

day5_morning_broadcast_4.speaker: me
day5_morning_broadcast_4.text: *Graduation ceremony. The words echoed through the hallway. Bouncing off walls, hitting the ceiling, coming back again.*

day5_morning_broadcast_5.speaker: eunsu
day5_morning_broadcast_5.text: {name}. Would you come to the classroom?

day5_morning_broadcast_7.speaker: me
day5_morning_broadcast_7.text: *The music box played one more measure — then cut off. The broadcast ended. Silence.*

day5_morning_broadcast_9.speaker: me
day5_morning_broadcast_9.text: *Yuna's voice is shaking. This girl has endured three years in this school. Three years without breaking. And now — she's trembling.*

day5_morning_broadcast_10.speaker: me
day5_morning_broadcast_10.text: We're not going. There's an escape route on the 3rd floor of the old wing that Seolhwa found.

day5_morning_broadcast_11.speaker: yuna
day5_morning_broadcast_11.text: ...The 3rd floor is just two flights of stairs from here—

day5_morning_broadcast_12.speaker: me
day5_morning_broadcast_12.text: *Thud. The sound of a door closing above. A heavy steel door closing.*

day5_morning_broadcast_13.speaker: me
day5_morning_broadcast_13.text: *Yuna stopped mid-sentence. We both looked up. Thud. Another one. The 3rd floor is sealed too.*

day5_morning_broadcast_15.speaker: me
day5_morning_broadcast_15.text: *Yuna grabbed my sleeve. Her fingers gripping tight.*

day5_morning_broadcast_17.speaker: me
day5_morning_broadcast_17.text: *There might not be. But if I break down here, it's over.*

day5_morning_broadcast_18.speaker: me
day5_morning_broadcast_18.text: *Only the classroom door is open. Every other door is locked. There's only one way to go.*

day5_morning_grad_1.speaker: yuna
day5_morning_grad_1.text: ...I'll wait outside. If I go in — they'll catch me too.

day5_morning_grad_3.speaker: yuna
day5_morning_grad_3.text: Don't be sorry. I'm okay. — When you come out, we run together.

day5_morning_grad_4.speaker: me
day5_morning_grad_4.text: *Yuna hid in the corner of the hallway. I pressed the record button on my phone.*

day5_morning_grad_6.speaker: me
day5_morning_grad_6.text: ***No one is here. 30 empty desks. All chairs facing the blackboard. Not arranged — placed. Someone deliberately turned every chair toward the blackboard.***

day5_morning_grad_7.speaker: me
day5_morning_grad_7.text: *On each desk, a name tag. Numbers 1 through 12. Cycle numbers and the names assigned then. — Seat 13 is empty. My seat.*

day5_morning_grad_8.speaker: me
day5_morning_grad_8.text: ***Written on the blackboard: 'Congratulations on Your Graduation — 13th'***

day5_morning_grad_9.speaker: me
day5_morning_grad_9.text: *The chalk writing is clean. Written this morning. The handwriting is familiar — Ms. Eunsu's. The same neat hand she always used in class.*

day5_morning_grad_10.speaker: me
day5_morning_grad_10.text: *Papers are stacked on the lectern. 13 of them. Each clipped together, with a photo attached. — They're all me. Same face. Different names.*

day5_morning_grad_12.speaker: me
day5_morning_grad_12.text: *Ms. Eunsu lifts the papers from the lectern. Her hands don't tremble. — She's used to this.*

day5_morning_grad_13.speaker: eunsu
day5_morning_grad_13.text: It's your diploma. In your name.

day5_morning_grad_14.speaker: me
day5_morning_grad_14.text: *The paper has 13 names written on it. From 'Kim Dojin' at the top to '{name}' at the bottom. They're not diplomas — they're 'Processing Complete Confirmations.' Stamped. 'Complete.' 'Complete.' 'Complete.' 12 'Completes.' Only the 13th slot is blank.*

day5_morning_grad_15.speaker: me
day5_morning_grad_15.text: *Ms. Eunsu turns over the first page. Kim Dojin. A sentence is written in red pen beside the photo.*

day5_morning_grad_16.speaker: me
day5_morning_grad_16.text: ***'Day 3 22:14. Attempted to leave through the front gate. Recovered.'***

day5_morning_grad_17.speaker: me
day5_morning_grad_17.text: *The second page. Lee Junseo. There is a small stain on the corner of the paper. I can't tell whether it's coffee or water.*

day5_morning_grad_18.speaker: me
day5_morning_grad_18.text: *The fifth page. Kang Minhyuk. The attached memo reads, 'Increased time spent in faculty office. Dependency response favorable.'*

day5_morning_grad_19.speaker: me
day5_morning_grad_19.text: *The sixth page. Jeong Hayul. A black clip over the photo. Beside it, a photo of a drug vial is attached.*

day5_morning_grad_20.speaker: me
day5_morning_grad_20.text: *On the seventh page, Ms. Eunsu's hand stops. Kim Taeho. Another photo is half tucked behind his. A white-haired schoolgirl. Her face has been deliberately cropped out.*

day5_morning_grad_21a.speaker: me
day5_morning_grad_21a.text: *The lectern drawer is half open. I can see a letter inside. 'Thanks to you, I had a wonderful school life.' The name is Song Yejun. The date is the night of Day 5 in the 10th cycle.*

day5_morning_grad_23.speaker: me
day5_morning_grad_23.text: *Picks up chopsticks with the left hand. Skips the third stair. Rests the right cheek in the hand when looking out the window. Shakes chocolate milk twice.*

day5_morning_grad_24.speaker: me
day5_morning_grad_24.text: *My habits are organized like a classroom observation chart.*

day5_morning_grad_25.speaker: eunsu
day5_morning_grad_25.text: ...Even when memories are erased, something remains.

day5_morning_grad_27.speaker: me
day5_morning_grad_27.text: *The silence stretches. What I saw was not a confession, but an old observation sheet.*

day5_morning_grad_29.speaker: me
day5_morning_grad_29.text: *She starts to say my name, then looks back at the checklist.*

day5_morning_grad_29a.speaker: me
day5_morning_grad_29a.text: *That expression is the strangest one yet. Not affection. The face of someone checking something she memorized.*

day5_morning_grad_30.speaker: eunsu
day5_morning_grad_30.text: ...If you have questions, ask them now.

day5_morning_grad_reply_1b.speaker: eunsu
day5_morning_grad_reply_1b.text: Yes. At first, it was observation. Even midway through, that is what I wrote in the reports. That was how I could keep going.

day5_morning_grad_reply_2.speaker: eunsu
day5_morning_grad_reply_2.text: ...At first, it was research. Orders from the board.

day5_morning_grad_reply_2b.speaker: me
day5_morning_grad_reply_2b.text: *Ms. Eunsu places a finger on the third page. It is stamped 'Extension Approval Request.' Applicant: Park Eunsu.*

day5_morning_grad_reply_2c.speaker: eunsu
day5_morning_grad_reply_2c.text: ...From here on, it has my signature.

day5_morning_grad_reply_3.speaker: me
day5_morning_grad_reply_3.text: *Ms. Eunsu smiled. The saddest smile I've ever seen.*

day5_morning_proposal_1.speaker: me
day5_morning_proposal_1.text: *Silence settled. Just the two of us left in the classroom.*

day5_morning_proposal_2.speaker: me
day5_morning_proposal_2.text: *Ms. Eunsu stepped away from the lectern. One step, two steps. Walking toward me. Stopped. — Two meters away.*

day5_morning_proposal_3.speaker: me
day5_morning_proposal_3.text: *Teacher's lips moved. No sound came out. Again.*

day5_morning_proposal_5.speaker: me
day5_morning_proposal_5.text: *Those two words filled the classroom. Teacher — knelt down. In front of the lectern. Among 30 empty desks.*

day5_morning_proposal_6.speaker: eunsu
day5_morning_proposal_6.text: I know. This isn't something an apology can fix.

day5_morning_proposal_7.speaker: me
day5_morning_proposal_7.text: *She does not look at the approval forms bearing her own name. As if she has already memorized them.*

day5_morning_proposal_9.speaker: eunsu
day5_morning_proposal_9.text: Still... when you're here, the numbers stabilize. No, I stabilize.

day5_morning_proposal_10.speaker: me
day5_morning_proposal_10.text: *Teacher stood up. Didn't wipe the tears. Just — like that.*

day5_morning_proposal_13.speaker: eunsu
day5_morning_proposal_13.text: One. Stay here. I'll leave your place as it is. I won't erase your memories.

day5_morning_proposal_14.speaker: eunsu
day5_morning_proposal_14.text: Two. Erase your memories. The pain and fear will be cleared. We can pass it to the next cycle.

day5_morning_end_cage.speaker: me
day5_morning_end_cage.text: *...My feet won't move. I sat down in the chair. Ms. Eunsu smiles.*

day5_morning_end_forget.speaker: me
day5_morning_end_forget.text: *...I closed my eyes. Ms. Eunsu's hand touches my forehead. It's cold.*

day5_morning_end_run.speaker: me
day5_morning_end_run.text: *My body moved first. The muscle memory of 12 cycles. My legs move faster than expected. — I ran.*
